model.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals Infused Olive Oil brings versatile cannabis wellness to your kitchen with 500mg of premium extract in every bottle. This culinary edible offers a sophisticated way to incorporate cannabis into your daily routine, whether drizzled over salads, mixed into dressings, or used in low-heat cooking. The smooth, earthy flavor profile complements both savory and sweet dishes while delivering consistent, long-lasting effects. Perfect for experienced consumers seeking creative control over their dosing, this infused oil allows you to customize your experience with every meal. Simply start with a small amount and wait 60-90 minutes to feel the full effects. Store in a cool, dark place to maintain potency and freshness. Elevate your culinary creations while enjoying the therapeutic benefits of cannabis with this premium infused olive oil.
